results.title: Actors Jang Dong-yoon and Kim Seung-yoon to marry in October
results.description: Actors Jang Dong-yoon and Kim Seung-yoon will marry in October in a small family wedding, following years of being together, BH Entertainment confirmed.

results.title: '1942: A Love Story' removed from several theatres: Why Anil Kapoor-Manisha Koirala-starrer has a limited release
results.description: The restored classic has returned to cinemas with upgraded picture and sound quality. But its new technical format has forced the makers to limit screenings to select theatres.
